title: The Lost Recipes at Sugar Palm
description: Dine on home-style, generational Khmer heritage recipes preserved by Chef Kethana Dunnet, widely considered the global authority on authentic Cambodia.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Chef Kethana Dunnet, a consultant for Gordon Ramsay and Luke Nguyen, offers authentic Khmer home cooking at Sugar Palm, featuring dishes like slow-cooked Pomelo Salad and a soufflé-like Fish Amok.
> * The private dining experience at Sugar Palm, lasting 2 hours with no physical demand, is best paired with temple exploration and is available year-round with advance booking.
> * Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this experience, ensuring a seamless, high-standard culinary journey.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Dine on home-style, generational Khmer heritage recipes preserved by Chef Kethana Dunnet, widely considered the global authority on authentic Cambodian home cooking.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Chef Kethana serves as a profound link to [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/)'s culinary past, preserving the nuanced, time-consuming techniques of home cooking that modern restaurants frequently bypass. She has served as a consultant for Gordon Ramsay and Luke Nguyen, ensuring the global accuracy of Khmer dishes.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
You will enjoy a private reservation at her beautifully designed restaurant. The menu focuses on dishes that require hours of preparation to build depth without aggressive heat. 

Must-orders include the slow-cooked Pomelo Salad, and her arguably definitive version of Fish Amok, which takes far longer to prepare than standard restaurant versions, resulting in a phenomenal, soufflé-like texture. It is a deeply comforting, enriching culinary experience.

## Unwinding Over Heritage Khmer Home Cooking After 18 Holes in Siem Reap
After navigating the deep bunkers and fast Ultra-Dwarf Bermuda greens of [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or crossing the 11th-century laterite bridge on the 18th hole at [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), golf groups often crave a warm, unpretentious dining room where authentic flavor takes precedence over stiff formality. Set inside a classic elevated wooden stilt house near the Old Market precinct of Siem Reap, **The Sugar Palm** delivers family-heirloom recipes refined by the late Chef Kethana Dunnet—whose kitchen famously schooled Gordon Ramsay and Luke Nguyen in traditional Khmer technique.

Situated less than 10 minutes from [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/), [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), and [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), the teak dining room and open veranda make an inviting setting for a fourball or eight-player group settling the day’s Nassau bets over shared plates.

## Family-Style Banquet Ordering & Concierge Coordination
* **Signature Heirloom Dishes:** Our concierge pre-orders Kethana’s benchmark creations so your table never waits on slow-steamed courses—highlighting the soufflé-light *Fish Amok* steamed in banana leaf cups, crisp pomelo salad tossed with toasted coconut and freshwater shrimp, caramelized pork belly with palm sugar (*Kaw Sach Chrouk*), and tangy tamarind duck.
* **Effortless Pacing Before Speakeasy Nightcaps:** A 7:00 PM reservation concludes around 9:00 PM, placing your group a three-minute stroll or two-minute SUV hop from [Miss Wong Cocktail Bar](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-miss-wong-cocktail-bar/) or [Asana Old Wooden House](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-asana-wooden-house-siem-reap/).

## Ideal Siem Reap Golf & Resort Pairings Around The Sugar Palm
Whether your group has spent the morning attacking the tight Seashore Paspalum fairways of [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/), navigating the water carries at [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), or stretching out across the 7,396-yard layout at [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/), returning to [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), or [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/) for an afternoon swim sets up an unhurried evening at The Sugar Palm. For groups of eight to sixteen players traveling on [The Khmer Temple Trail](/tours/the-khmer-temple-trail/), our Siem Reap concierge reserves the entire upper teak veranda so your fourballs can award daily green jackets over banana-leaf *Fish Amok* and chilled Sauvignon Blanc before heading to [Miss Wong Cocktail Bar](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-miss-wong-cocktail-bar/).

faqs.q: Why is The Sugar Palm a favorite dinner spot for golfers visiting Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Set in an airy traditional teak house 10 minutes from Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor and Jaya House River Park, The Sugar Palm serves generous, family-style Khmer classics—like soufflé Fish Amok and pomelo salad—ideal for groups of 4 to 12 players after a round at Angkor Golf Resort.

faqs.q: What makes The Sugar Palm's Fish Amok different from standard tourist restaurants in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Founded by Chef Kethana Dunnet, the kitchen hand-pounds fresh Kroeung paste daily and whisks coconut cream with Tonle Sap snakehead fish to achieve an airy, mousse-like soufflé steamed in individual banana-leaf cups.

faqs.q: Can Asia Golf Specialists arrange a pre-set sharing banquet at The Sugar Palm for our golf group?
faqs.a: Yes. For groups of 6 or more golfers, our Siem Reap concierge pre-selects a multi-course Khmer sharing banquet and reserves a dedicated teak veranda table with private return transfers.
